name: European Resources Limited
summary: Operating with its subsidiaries, European Resources Limited undertakes mineral exploration projects across Finland and Slovakia. The company's prospecting efforts target a wide range of deposits, including gold, silver, copper, cobalt, nickel, zinc, lead, vanadium, lithium, beryllium, and various rare earth elements. Formerly known as Prospech Limited, the firm adopted its current name, European Resources Limited, in December 2025. It was established in 2014 and its corporate headquarters are situated in Sydney, Australia.
